facts.business: IDREAM FILM INFRASTRUCTURE COMPANY LIMITED (formerly SOFTBPO GLOBAL SERVICES LIMITED) is a company with negative net worth and accumulated losses, currently exploring new business opportunities under changed management.

auditor.name: Kanu Doshi Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: The Company has incurred net losses in past years and current year, accumulated losses exceed net worth resulting in negative net worth; financial statements prepared on going concern basis considering change in management and exploration of new business opportunities.

key_risks: Negative net worth and accumulated losses exceeding net worth
Going concern uncertainty despite management change and new business exploration
